annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Changed drizzle `encryptedType` dataType() to return the pre-quoted `"public"."eql_v2_encrypted"`. drizzle-kit's ALTER COLUMN path quotes it again and prefixes `"undefined".`, producing invalid SQL; the migration rewriter regex did not match the new mangled form, so broken ALTERs reached users (0.15.0).

known_defects.description: Pre-quoted schema-qualified type name makes drizzle-kit generate invalid ALTER COLUMN SQL that the rewriter does not catch
known_defects.mechanism: drizzle-kit wraps dataType() in quotes and prefixes typeSchema for ALTER
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that returning a quoted / schema-qualified type string from dataType() can be mis-rendered by drizzle-kit (double quoting, 'undefined' schema) in generated migrations, or that the rewriter regex will not match the forms drizzle-kit emits.
